attBesluta.text: Parfait pour traiter une parcelle de 1800M2 avec une tondeuse autoportée après un montage plutôt simple à comprendre. Produit solide et bien protégé contre l'érosion provoquée par les produits de traitement. Je le recommande à ceux qui hésitent encore. il est bien meilleur que celui que je possédais jusqu'à lors.
Went together very easy and appears to be solid and well built. I haven’t used it yet but it looks good.

I really do love this hand truck/trolley. However the only reason I do not give it 5 stars is that I cannot slide it under a stack of boxes. I have to manually stack the boxes onto it. I did not catch that when I purchased it as I was focused on the stair climbing capabilities which work awesomely. Other than that it truly is a good piece of equipment.
Product is quite good, it was a long time coming and I missed out on using it due delay. Product good service just ok.

It seems to be well made and quite strong but as yet I have not had the need to try it out with a load. It is a little difficult to get used to opening and closing it but that is just a matter of doing it several times so it becomes second nature. Very good value for money, expecially when compared other hand trucks of a similar kind.
Excelente precio/calidad! Dude si comprarlo la verdad, pero esta buenisimo…
Very nice tent. I had a minor problem with one of the strings. Vevor came up with a fantastic soloution. I recomment.

We love this tent, there are two small screened windows, and 2 doors that open with no screen. The bottom just clips on. We did sleep in it, but keep in mind the bottom is not sealed tight and it gets very warm. We plan to do an evening dinner in it, doors open with a fan. It comes with a shade cover. Very easy to assemble and put away, at least two people to set up, I took down by myself.
